{{Quote|Good shot, Red Two!|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]|<ref name="Return of the Jedi">{{Film|VI}}</ref>}}
"'''Red Two'''" was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who fought at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. He piloted a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing starfighter]] and shot down at least three [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptors]], the first of which shot down [[Sila Kott/Legends|Red Three]].<ref name="Return of the Jedi" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Red Two, peel off and take the rest of the assault wing back to the surface. Try to get those TIE fighters and make them follow you out.''"<br />"''Copy, Gold Leader.|Lando Calrissian and Red Two, in the ''Return of the Jedi'' radio drama|<ref name="ROTJ radio drama">[[Return of the Jedi (radio)|''Return of the Jedi'' radio drama]], chapter six: Blood of a Jedi</ref>}}
This character appears in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], and is addressed as "Red Two" by Wedge Antilles during the Battle of Endor.<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> ''[[Star Wars: The Annotated Screenplays]]'' simply attributes his line "I'm on it, Gold Leader," to "Rebel Pilot," although the followup line by Antilles is still "Good shot, Red Two!"<ref name="Annotated Screenplays ">''[[Star Wars: The Annotated Screenplays]]''</ref>

Red Two appears to be played by the same actor who portrays [[Gray Leader/Legends|Gray Leader]],<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> a character later [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] as being the [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe's]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Horton Salm/Legends|Horton Salm]]. The [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]'s ''[[Death Star II Limited]]'' set even uses a picture of Red Two, identifiable from cockpit lighting that only appears during Red Two's "I'm on it, Gold Leader" line, on the front of Salm's character card.<ref name="Horton hears a Red Two">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Colonel Salm}}</ref>

[[File:Colonel_salm.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Red Two's doppelganger: Gray Leader]]
Similarly, the [[2004]] [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi (junior novelization)|junior novelization]] of ''Return of the Jedi'' credits Gray Leader as the speaker of the line "I'm on it, Gold Leader," but it also states immediately afterward that "Red Two swooped in to lend a hand, and the TIE fighters were decimated."<ref name="ROTJ junior novel chapter ">[[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi (junior novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' junior novelization]]</ref> As the film itself depicts Antilles exclaiming "Good shot, Red Two!" after this article's subject destroys a TIE Interceptor,<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> this article assumes that in ''[[Star Wars]]'' Legends canon, Red Two and Gray Leader are different people. In ''Star Wars''{{'s}} post-[[2014]] rebooted [[Canon|continuity]], author [[Jason Fry]] attempted to clear up the confusion by creating Salm's younger brother, [[Keyser Salm]], whom he intended to be Red Two.<ref name="Jason Fry TFN">{{JCFCite|url=posts/57106198|board=Literature|thread=From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back|user=jasonfry|date=2020-12-22|quote=Someone in this very thread got it shortly after the book came out. Red Two at Endor is apparently portrayed by the same guy who plays Gray Leader. So I made them brothers. A geeky little lore thing, but there was a way to address it that helped the story I wanted to tell, so why not?}} {{C|Responding to "@jasonfry so Mr. Fry, now that the book has been out over a month, care to tell us the story of one Mr. Keyser Salm?" regarding "[[Rendezvous Point (short story)|''Rendezvous Point'']]"}}</ref>

Early in the ''Return of the Jedi''{{'s}} battle, the [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing]] pilot [[Sila Kott/Legends|Sila Kott]] responds to a command from Antilles of "[[Red Three/Legends|Red Three]], Red Two, pull in," which by itself suggests that she is either Red Two or Red Three.<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> The [[Hasbro]] action figure set "Battle Over Endor," names her as Red Two,<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Shadows of the Dark Side|pack=(Toys R Us Exclusive) Battle Over Endor (1 of 2)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TVCEXBattleOverEndor1.asp}}</ref> and her line "Got it!" is attributed to Red Two in both ''The Annotated Screenplays''<ref name="Annotated Screenplays " /> and the film's junior novelization.<ref name="ROTJ junior novel chapter " /> However, due to Antilles' explicit identification of this article's subject as Red Two later in the film, this article again defers to ''Return of the Jedi'' itself and assumes that in Kott is in fact Red Three in ''Star Wars'' Legends continuity.<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> She has been explicitly named as Red Three at least once in the new canon.<ref name="2017 A-wing book">''[[Star Wars: A-wing Deluxe Book and 3D Wood Model]]''</ref>

In the [[Return of the Jedi (radio)|''Return of the Jedi'' radio drama]], Red Two follows [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] into the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star]] and is then instructed to head back to the surface to draw away some of the attacking TIE fighters.<ref name="ROTJ radio drama" /> In the film, this role belongs to [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green Squadron]] pilot [[Jake Farrell/Legends|Jake Farrell]].<ref name="Return of the Jedi" />
